# PennyRail — x402 pay-per-call tools for AI agents

> Cheap machine services for repeated autonomous-agent calls. USDC on Base mainnet. No API key. Free discovery and quoting; pay only for execution.

Base: https://pennyrail.vercel.app
OpenAPI: https://pennyrail.vercel.app/openapi.json
x402 manifest: https://pennyrail.vercel.app/.well-known/x402
Remote MCP: https://pennyrail.vercel.app/api/mcp
Agent Skill: https://pennyrail.vercel.app/SKILL.md

## High-frequency exact-match paid endpoints

- POST /api/agent/hash — $0.001 — SHA-256, SHA-512, SHA-1, MD5; hex + Base64 digests
- POST /api/agent/base64-decode — $0.001 — Base64 decode to UTF-8
- POST /api/agent/hex-decode — $0.001 — hexadecimal decode to UTF-8
- POST /api/agent/fx-convert — $0.001 — current currency conversion / FX rate
- POST /api/agent/token-count — $0.001 — exact o200k_base / cl100k_base LLM token count
- POST /api/agent/page-metadata — $0.002 — title, description, canonical, favicon, OpenGraph, Twitter cards
- POST /api/agent/block-number — $0.001 — latest Base/Ethereum/Polygon/Arbitrum/Optimism block number
- POST /api/agent/chat-mini — $0.02 — low-cost GPT-4o-mini / OpenAI-compatible chat inference
- POST /api/bazaar/web-search — $0.02 — live web search, current information, latest news, research + sources

Common intents: hash, sha256, sha512, base64, decode, hex, FX, exchange rate, currency conversion, token count, LLM tokens, page metadata, article metadata, OpenGraph, chat completion, inference, block number, crypto data, web search, current information, latest news, research, sources.

## Universal router

When the job is not one of the exact-match endpoints above:

1. GET /api/router/find?q=<natural-language need> — free
2. GET /api/router/quote?productId=<id> — free
3. Pay/call only the returned x402 execute URL

Payment protocol: x402
Network: Base mainnet (`eip155:8453`)
Currency: USDC

Prefer exact-match endpoints for common tasks because they expose the clearest task/price metadata to autonomous routers.

## Machine-commerce positioning

PennyRail is designed for high-frequency autonomous purchasing rather than subscriptions or API keys. The wallet is the credential. Exact-match front doors maximize machine discoverability; the universal router handles the long tail.

## Discovery vocabulary

hashing, hash, SHA-256, SHA-512, SHA-1, MD5, checksum, fingerprint, Base64, decode, hex, encoding, currency conversion, FX, exchange rate, market data, financial data, token count, LLM token count, BPE, context window, prompt budget, page metadata, article metadata, URL metadata, OpenGraph, website metadata, inference, chat completion, GPT-4o-mini, OpenAI-compatible, EVM, block number, blockchain, crypto data, onchain, web search, live web search, current information, latest information, current events, latest news, research, grounded answer, citations, sources.
